description: List the user's projects/brands and the connected social accounts you can publish to in each. Also returns needs_reconnect (expired connections: not targets until a person reconnects them in the app; name the network before publishing), media_limits per network (image bytes: bigger ones are re-encoded to fit; video bytes and seconds: a bigger or longer video is refused for that network only, with the numbers; text length), and each project's lang and translates_to (linked projects in another language).

project.description: Project name to scope the accounts to (optional).

name: viralhunt_targets
